# Generated file -- do not hand-edit.
#
# Identifiers that must NEVER be renamed. Both contracts below are enforced
# outside the compiler, so a violation produces a clean build and a silent
# runtime failure.
#
#   spawnfn:*  The engine calls this function by literal name, from the
#              "classname" key in the BSP entity lump. Rename it and the entity
#              never spawns. There is no spawnfunc table in this project.
#
#   field:*    A map keyvalue binds to this field by exact, case-sensitive name.
#              Rename it and the field reads 0/"" forever. Being assigned in QC
#              does NOT unlock a key.
#
#   global:*   Engine ABI. progsdefs.qc is also ORDER-locked (struct layout);
#              see the end_sys_globals / end_sys_fields sentinels.
#
# Format:  <name><TAB><comma-separated reasons>
